AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#694 @ 61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178 — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/0

Lens: AUD-SOL-CI-117, agent 117. Independent **T4** audit of all three changed files (+1149/-2), including every round-2 guard and companion-probe line, the effective workflow, TypeScript program and options, default/live Jest inheritance, pinned compiler implementation and live required-check settings. [Exact candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178)

### Prior findings — explicit closure

| Finding | Disposition and evidence |
|---|---|
| **Sol B-694-1** | **Closed.** `test/ci/jest-typecheck-gate.spec.ts:172–335` resolves the effective step/job/workflow working directory, permits only the exact unmasked `npx tsc --noEmit` command, parses the real effective project through TypeScript, and rejects each disabled effective strict-family flag and noCheck; `:417–455` checks every repository file reached by a normalized ts-jest transform against that program. Both original counterexamples failed the builder's desired rejection assertions before repair and now pass them at this head. [Prior finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/694#issuecomment-5976120709) [Guard repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/test/ci/jest-typecheck-gate.spec.ts#L172-L455) [Failing before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174744226) [Passing exact-head full CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175877382/job/111358251786) |
| **Sol C-694-2** | **Closed.** `:337–369,406–415,460–480` resolves the installed CLI's own jest-config, rejects proportional limits and compares the normalized absolute limit with the Test heap cap; current `'2GB'` remains valid and numeric `0.9` no longer passes. [Memory guard](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/test/ci/jest-typecheck-gate.spec.ts#L337-L480) [Failing before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174744226) [Passing exact-head full CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175877382/job/111358251786) |
| **Opus C-694-1 / C-694-2** | Their reported boundaries are independently repaired: the repository-wide transform walk includes scripts/prisma sources, and any build-and-test job-level if is rejected. Both black-box mutations fail against the old guard and pass as rejection tests at this head; this disposition does not substitute for Opus's independent verdict. [Boundary regressions, failing before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175679844) [Current guard and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/test/ci/jest-typecheck-gate-probes.spec.ts#L169-L177) [Passing exact-head full CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175877382/job/111358251786) |

### Independent boundary proof

A tests-only CI-lane branch runs this exact guard unchanged in a VM with real TypeScript project parsing, real file enumeration and the installed Jest normalizer: masked tsc status, narrow effective project, explicit strictFunctionTypes override, inherited noCheck, exclusion of one spec, skipped Type-check, an inherited failure-masking shell and fractional worker memory each produce its specific rejection diagnostic, bracketed by unchanged-input and working-directory-precedence controls; **90/90 assertions pass across all four suites**, including the original guards and branch-protection controls. [Independent Sol probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177683513)

The first probe run had 89 passing assertions and one probe-harness ENOENT because the virtual extended config lacked a stat view; that tests-only harness was corrected rather than treating the red run as a flake or a candidate defect, and the original red execution is preserved. [Original probe diagnostic](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177534050)

### Gate preservation and evidence applicability

- No workflow, root/build TypeScript config, package script, dependency or required-check name changes in the PR; `build-and-test` still has that exact reported name and the real root Type-check succeeds before Test, with no conditional/error masking. The default and live RLS configs inherit the same transpile-only transformer. [Exact workflow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L10-L92) [Live inheritance](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/jest.rls.config.js) [Required-name enforcement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/61d42f09077a1786b48ab68164f9e4921a795178/test/ci/branch-protection-checks.spec.ts)
- Exact-head full CI reports **716 passed suites, 12,390 passed tests, 23 skipped suites and Jest 190.974 seconds**, with both changed guard suites passing; the skipped live-DB suites are separately exercised by required live jobs. [Exact-head build-and-test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175877382/job/111358251786)
- All **11 live configured required checks are SUCCESS** at the rechecked exact head immediately before this verdict; approval is an audit result, not deployment or integrated-release acceptance. [Candidate checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/694/checks)
- Evidence reuse is bounded: the prior Sol verdict was REQUEST CHANGES, not an inherited approval; every new guard/probe line was audited afresh. Historical root-cause and suite-parity evidence remains applicable to the byte-identical Jest transform and pinned Jest/ts-jest/TypeScript versions, while the main merge and exact-head full CI were verified separately. The merge tree exactly matches main reconciliation, and the only own round-2 files are the two guards. [Prior Sol evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/694#issuecomment-5976120709) [Main merge](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/8346b1ac) [Round 2](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/694#issuecomment-5976567947)

No open A/B/C findings. No candidate-branch edit, local heavy execution, production operation, merge or deployment was performed by this lens.
